historicalContracts.name: ChainTypeManager
historicalContracts.note: ChainTypeManager on the Gateway settlement layer defining upgrade data and the proof system for Era's gateway DiamondProxy while Era settled via Gateway (Era L1 Diamond had a non-zero getSettlementLayer): compromise pushes a malicious upgrade/verifier onto Era's gateway instance, forging Era state whose message roots relay to L1 and release the L1 escrows.

historicalContracts.name: DiamondProxy
historicalContracts.note: Era's own DiamondProxy (getChainId 324) on the Gateway settlement layer where Era batches were committed, proven and executed while it settled via Gateway: a malicious facet cut or verifier swap forges Era batches with fake L2->L1 withdrawal logs that relay to Ethereum and drain Era's L1 escrows.
